scope: Qualified Windows/Linux x64 default-off standalone collector; focused lifecycle and execution-cost vertical, not the full P9 ledger or production qualification.
scan_counter_32: Actual initialization rounds plus successful external rescans; not every external scan call and not CoreCLR's internal table-loop pass count.
scan_cpu_scope_entries: Current-thread CPU deltas exist only for indices 4 through 31; these and wall scopes are nested, on multiple actors, and not additive exclusive GC CPU.
windows_cpu_clock: Quantized GetThreadTimes and process-clock deltas can be zero for real short work.
parent_process_wall: Includes runtime startup, graph setup, hashing, measured work and shutdown. Subtracting region wall does not isolate pure startup or OS retirement.
memory_observations: Separate intrusive single-process observations and read-only glibc XML diagnostics; not replacement latency samples or proof of OS release.
